_about: Corrections to the lexicon data, applied by build.py. 'hide' drops an entry that belongs to a different word spelled alike; 'fix' replaces a dictionary form STEPBible tagged wrongly. Each found by the drafters while reading the briefs.

q6-10.why: Gesenius's שִׁבֹּלֶת here is the homonym 'a branch', not 'an ear of grain'.

r4-15.why: Gesenius's entry here is the homonym 'to make a loud noise', not 'to be evil'.

g1-06.why: Gesenius's entry here is the adjective 'narrow', not 'adversary'.

i22-08.why: Gesenius's entry here is the homonym 'to set, as the sun', not 'to pledge'.

u8-15.why: STEPBible tags this word as נָשָׂא, 'lift up'; in this verse it is נָשָׁא, 'lend on interest, exact'.

u8-19.why: STEPBible tags this word as גַּל, 'heap'; it is גָּדוֹל, 'great'.

m4-12.why: STEPBible tags this word as גַּל, 'heap'; it is גָּדוֹל, 'great'.
